bio: Torben Mucchetti is a singer-songwriter and guitar player based in Knoxville, Tennessee. His original music blends folk and alternative country with blues-influenced guitar playing.
Built around honest songwriting, acoustic textures, and expressive guitar work, Torben’s sound draws from the storytelling of folk and alt-country and the feel of the blues.
Whether he’s performing solo or with his band, he brings those influences together onstage through original songs and guitar-driven arrangements.
